text: オツキミやまで　いっつも　キノコの　ポケモン　とってるの！

structure.jp: キノコの　ポケモン　とってるの！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows something is going on or done regularly; てる is the short spoken form. とってる = 'I am catching', 'I catch'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives a soft 'you see' feeling, often in children's or women's speech. とってるの = 'I catch them, you see'.
